question.value: What are the molecular gas and 230 GHz continuum (core and jet) properties of nearby LERGs, and how do the gas discs relate to the radio jets, to inform the AGN fuelling/feedback cycle?

evidence.quote: We are conducting an extensive study of different galaxy components (stars, warm and cold gas, radio jets) with the aim of improving our understanding of the AGN fuelling/feedback cycle in LERGs.
